picks.what: The Institute of Emperor Nicholas I, housed in the Branicki Palace, postcard
picks.why: labeled Białystok postcard of the palace grounds and park, the town’s chief landmark; the other P4 candidates are plain street scenes; caption and border trimmed

gaps: P0–P2: nothing; P3: only an 1849 ground plan of the Orthodox church; P6: only a view over a university car park and 2020 construction sites
notes: The building shown may be a wing of the palace complex rather than its main front; the card names the institute, as the postcard does. #8 (commercial school seen from a height) is dated only “before 1918”, so not used next to the existing 1915–18 aerial view.
